text:
Maya: Quick design sync  new proposal to declutter the roles matrix for org admins. Goal: faster scan, fewer clicks to audit events.

Noah: Saw the frames. Two concerns: legend density when many roles, and SSO control copy pushes layout.

Oliver: Suggestion: show compact role tiles with a small 'Details' button (keyboard focusable) that toggles an inline panel. Not hover-only.

Hana: Accessibility note: toggles and details must have aria-expanded, visible focus indicators, and the expanded heading should receive programmatic focus (tabindex=-1). Contrast on tiles >= 4.5.

Sam: Engineering: lazy-load details for orgs > 100 roles, animate height (150ms) to minimize layout shift, and focus after animationend. Debounce rapid toggles.

Rae: SSO microcopy: shorten to "Enforce SSO  recommended." Add a small tertiary CTA "View SSO events" next to it that deep-links to the audit with a pre-filter.

Maya: Where to put the audit CTA? Inline by the toggle and also keep the top toolbar audit link. Redundancy helps discoverability.

Oliver: I'll mock two variants: inline expander and a slide-over side panel for details (less shifting). We'll test which yields faster task completion.

Hana: Modal and confirmation rules: modal must trap focus, title tabindex=-1, Esc closes. Confirmation panel after enabling SSO should focus the title and show primary CTA labeled "Start SSO rollout".

Sam: Backend already tags events as "sso.enforce". Deep-link pattern: /orgs/:id/audit?filter=event_type%3Asso.enforce (URL-encoded). I'll implement the link and an aria-live region for rollout status.

Maya: Action items: Oliver  upload updated mocks with keyboard states; Hana  a11y checklist for expanders/modal; Sam  deep-link + focus prototype; Rae  refine SSO copy. We'll run a 5-person usability check next week.

Noah: Thanks. Keep modal copy shortone-liner + 1 bullet. Make sure all CTAs are explicit for screen readers.
